rules.observed: takes is a numeric planning field and status is a set of independent booleans
rules.proposed: Store actual Take and Asset records; distinguish planning acknowledgement from media approval

rules.observed: Workflow centres on a social-video hook, one CTA and vertical output
rules.proposed: Apply hook and CTA presets to social; use dramatic beats and story arc for cinema

rules.observed: Full prompt override returns before bible and staging compilation
rules.proposed: Separate creative overrides from locked shot invariants and record compiled prompt versions

rules.observed: A repeated character bible is treated as a casting lock
rules.proposed: Use versioned visual references, continuity states and footage review; do not promise identity from prompt alone

rules.observed: Content changes do not invalidate existing scene approval and project QC flags
rules.proposed: Attach review to revisions and mark affected dependent checks stale without deleting old media

rules.observed: Timelapse transitions reduce runtime while labels and QC marks use original scene times
rules.proposed: Compile picture, subtitle, audio and QC timing from one frame-based render timeline

rules.observed: Centisecond carry and cue-duration edge cases exist; cue allocation is based on sentence lengths
rules.proposed: Use total-time rounding, positive cue validation and alignment to real audio

rules.observed: Short clips are extended by cloning their last frame and video is cropped to centre
rules.proposed: Record degraded or reframed media decisions and review them against shot intent

rules.observed: Fixed beat gain and default removal of clip audio
rules.proposed: Use independent sound tracks and source-aware mixing; retain useful audio by edit decision

rules.observed: Text pack and numbered clip/voice filenames form the asset contract
rules.proposed: Add stable shot/take IDs, checksums, probe metadata, rights and timeline revision to a manifest
